channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dejounte Murray | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dejounte Murray from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Trae Young on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Trae Young:

“I can play multiple ways. A lot of people just see what I've done and me being ball-dominant. I can't wait to show other things. My boy Dejounte Murray, who's with me 24/7, he was my point guard for a lot of years and I was just a shooter. I didn't do nothing but just shoot the ball. So I can't wait to show that. But also, yes, you can win with a smaller guard, of course. It's been done before.”

Trae Young on Dejounte Murray, Jun 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kyle Korver on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
“Trae and Dejounte really were both trying to make it work, but it was more of, like, Should I do this or should you do this? and then, You do it and I will stay out of it, which meant neither could really be their full best self,”

Kyle Korver on Dejounte Murray, Mar 6, 2025. Source: SLAM.

item.title: Willie Green on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Willie Green on Dejounte Murray's approach to the game amid team's struggles:

“Don't feel like you have to play with the weight of the world on your shoulders. It's not all on him. It's all of us. We understand the adversity we're facing. For him, just go out and be yourself.”

Willie Green on Dejounte Murray, Dec 21, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: David Griffin on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Meanwhile, Murray sank three game-winning baskets for Atlanta in ’23-24.

“If you look at last year and the things we struggled with in terms of closing out close games, one of the things we’re most excited about with Dejounte is that’s something he’s really comfortable with,”

David Griffin on Dejounte Murray, Jul 13, 2024. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: David Griffin on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
David Griffin on the Dejounte Murray acquisition:

“Dejounte is among the best two-way guards in the NBA and adds another dimension to our team, and we could not be more excited to welcome him and his family to New Orleans.”

David Griffin on Dejounte Murray, Jul 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.

item.title: Trey Alexander on Dejounte Murray, Trae Young
item.description:
Trey Alexander:

“I watch a lot of Dejounte Murray. Kind of those guys that play the two-way spot. They have the ball in their hands, but they also play with good guards. Obviously, he plays with Trae Young, he has to be able to be that second option, so that’s kinda a guy that I watch a lot of film on.”

Trey Alexander on Dejounte Murray, Trae Young, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Mazzulla on KP/Murray switch:

“Those are good reps for us. We went to that on purpose. We had an opportunity to practice stuff that we're gonna need to get to and we haven't done a lot of 1-5 switching with KP on the floor. So I thought that was a good opportunity for us.”

Joe Mazzulla on Dejounte Murray, Mar 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @John_Karalis.

item.title: Tre Jones on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Tre Jones, on this Dejounte Murray stuff:

“Dejounte is a real good guy. I feel like a lot of the things that happened when he separated from here and got traded, a lot of things happened that made him out to be a bad guy a little bit. I don’t think it’s anything like that.”

Tre Jones on Dejounte Murray, Jan 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Nate McMillan on Dejounte Murray:

“I think he's a leader. He has a voice, but he leads by example. His presence out on the floor commands respect. The guys that he has played with – which is mostly that first unit – they have responded to him being out on the floor.”

Nate McMillan on Dejounte Murray, Sep 30, 2022. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Paul George on Dejounte Murray, Paolo Banchero
item.description:
“Good entertainment, that Orlando-Atlanta matchup, that Paolo [Banchero], Dejounte [Murray] sh*t. But they from the same city, so pretty sure it's all for the love of the game.”

Paul George on Dejounte Murray, Paolo Banchero, Aug 10, 2022. Source: Twitter.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
All-StarDeMar DeRozan, on the Spurs' Dejounte Murray:

“He should be an All-Star. I wish their record was a lot better. There’s not too many point guards I could pick over Dejounte Murray.”

DeMar DeRozan on Dejounte Murray, Jan 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.

item.title: Ja Morant on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Ja Morant on Dejounte Murray:

“Dejounte is my guy, very special player. He does a lot for his team. As far as me, no matter who I am out there against, I try to do the same thing – play my game. I feel like I’ve been doing quite well this season.”

Ja Morant on Dejounte Murray, May 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Coach Pop on today's game:

“We wanted to get a good workout I guess conditioning wise. Get some rhythm for Jakob, Dejounte, and DeMar. Don’t get anybody hurt. The young guys got to play a lot against a Phoenix bench that is pretty veteran.”

Gregg Popovich on Dejounte Murray, May 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: Lonnie Walker on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Lonnie on Dejounte:

“He’s hitting his stride. What people expected out of Dejounte being a point guard, being a leader of this team, he’s handling it greatly. And as the season continues to go forward, he is continuing to get better each and every day.”

Lonnie Walker on Dejounte Murray, Apr 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on DeMar, Patty & Jakob resting tonight:

“As the season goes on, you look at schedule and minutes played and that sort of thing, people need to take a break. We did this with Dejounte a bit in the past and these guys need it tonight. They have hit the wall.”

Gregg Popovich on Dejounte Murray, Apr 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Pop on Murray, who returns to the starting lineup after missing one game with a sore foot:

“He’s gotten more confidence scoring wise, decision making. He’s better. He’s trying to fulfill another job as far as setting the tone defensively for us. He’s improved in several areas.”

Gregg Popovich on Dejounte Murray, Apr 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Patty Mills, Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on resting Murray & Mills at end of a 5-game, 7-day road trip:

“As you can imagine, it takes its toll. We just decided with this increased density in the schedule since the All-Star break we needed to help them stay in good shape.”

Gregg Popovich on Patty Mills, Dejounte Murray, Mar 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Will Hardy on Dejounte Murray, Derrick White
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Coach Hardy on Dejounte Murray and Derrick White's impact even when shots aren't falling:

“Well they’re good basketball players. Shooting is not going to define their impact on a game. They made good decisions tonight. They really helped get our offense going.”

Will Hardy on Dejounte Murray, Derrick White, Jul 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: Tim Duncan on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Duncan on Dejounte Murray:

“His confidence & aggression are going up. They are going in the right direction and he’s big for us. He’s going to have to be big for us. He needs experience, he needs time on the floor & he needs situational experience. He’s going to be a good one.”

Tim Duncan on Dejounte Murray, Mar 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Pop on LA:

“He spent a lot of time this summer, working on his body. He came in during open gym and continued to work in the weight room and on the court, really dedicated, knowing he has a good group coming around him. He’s as excited about Dejounte as much anybody else.”

Gregg Popovich on Dejounte Murray, Oct 23, 2019. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Jeff McDonald:DeMar DeRozan on Dejounte Murray's injury:

“All you can do is hope for the best and hope it’s not as bad as it looked.”

DeMar DeRozan on Dejounte Murray, Oct 7, 2018. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.

item.title: LaMarcus Aldridge on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Jeff Garcia:LaMarcus Aldridge on D. Murray's injury:

“You just feel for him because he’s worked so hard to be ready for this season.”

LaMarcus Aldridge on Dejounte Murray, Oct 7, 2018. Source: Twitter @JeffGSpursZone.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Pop, on Dejounte Murray:

“Other players are going to have to run like they’ve never run before, because he’s going to go. If they want to get the ball, they’re going to have to run with him.”

Gregg Popovich on Dejounte Murray, Sep 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Second-year proDejounte Murray has replaced Tony Parker as the Spurs starting point guard and coach Gregg Popovich said Parker handled the change with class.

“He was great. He thought it was good for the team, and giving Dejounte a chance to see what he could do. (Parker) was mature, and really made it easy on me to make a decision like that. He was fantastic.”

Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Dejounte Murray, Jan 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @claybailey9.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Leonard on Murray:

“He did a good job, being thrown into the fire like that, starting on the road... He'll be better next game, for sure.”

Kawhi Leonard on Dejounte Murray, May 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
